## ===== ImmoScout24 =====
## Beschreibung
Dear Prospective Buyer,
Discover an exceptional first-occupancy penthouse where contemporary elegance, premium craftsmanship, and generous outdoor living come together in perfect harmony.
Offering approximately 132.06 m² of beautifully designed living space, four light-filled rooms, and two spectacular private terraces, this residence is designed for those who value comfort, privacy, and quality without compromise.
Highlights

- Elegant herringbone hardwood flooring
- Underfloor heating & air conditioning
- Two private terraces
- KNX smart home system
- Video intercom system
- Electrically operated external blinds
The entire building has been comprehensively renovated, creating a prestigious residence that combines timeless architecture with modern luxury.
A rare opportunity to own a home that offers not only exceptional quality, but a lifestyle defined by elegance and exclusivity. Arrange your private viewing today.
Vertragserrichtung: Mag. Gottgeisl (1,5 % v. KP zzgl. 20 % u. Barauslagen)
Wir weisen darauf hin, dass zwischen dem Vermittler und dem zu vermittelnden Dritten ein familiäres oder wirtschaftliches Naheverhältnis besteht.
Der Vermittler ist als Doppelmakler tätig.

## Lage
It is located in Vienna's 17th district (Hernals), offering excellent public transport connections. The nearby tram lines **2, 9, and 43** provide direct access to the city centre and other key destinations.

The neighborhood features supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, schools, and everyday amenities within walking distance. Nearby green spaces include **Kongresspark**, **Türkenschanzpark**, and **Schwarzenbergpark**, offering ample opportunities for recreation and outdoor activities.
